question: A man sold two TV sets for ₹ 7,200 each, neither incurring a gain nor a loss. If he sold one TV set at a profit of 12(1)/(2) %, then the other TV set is sold at a loss of:
solution:
Given:

A man sold two TV sets for ₹ 7,200 each neither incurring a gain nor a loss.

He sold one TV set at a profit of 12(1)/(2) % i.e. 12.5%

Concept used:

Loss
